title: AIFT Living Atlas
description: Evidence-backed present-tense map of public Federation entities and their explicit typed mappings to canonical Tree of Emergence node IDs.

boundaries.canonicalMeaning: The Tree of Emergence defines canonical lineage and meaning in manifests/tree.manifest.json.
boundaries.instantiatedReality: The Living Atlas records public entities, documents, services, and repositories that currently instantiate or express Tree concepts.
boundaries.observedRuntime: Runtime overlays may later report live observed state, but they must not redefine either Tree meaning or Atlas entity identity.

people-community.label: People / Community
people-community.definition: A person, group, community, or stewarded social body visible by consent.

repository.label: Repository
repository.definition: A public or governed source repository with inspectable files, history, role, and evidence.

project.label: Project
project.definition: A bounded initiative, product lane, or workstream that may span repositories and documents.

trust.label: Trust
trust.definition: A sovereign trust, trust seed, or governed stewardship body.

publication.label: Publication
publication.definition: A paper, review packet, source summary, public PDF, or other authored knowledge artifact.

agent.label: Agent
agent.definition: A bounded role, assistant, workflow actor, or repo-agent pattern with explicit authority limits.

service.label: Service
service.definition: A public or internal software surface that users can operate or inspect.

infrastructure.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure.definition: Hosting, routing, deployment, compute, naming, or provider-node substrate.

governance.label: Governance
governance.definition: Decision, consent, authority, policy, or review structure.

economic-system.label: Economic System
economic-system.definition: Value, wallet, currency, stewardship, market, or regenerative economy architecture.

place.label: Place
place.definition: A public, shared, or private location record governed by Atlas visibility and consent rules.

research-package.label: Research Package
research-package.definition: A reproducible or reviewable research bundle with scripts, data policy, outputs, and limitations.

expresses.label: Expresses
expresses.definition: The Atlas entity expresses a Tree concept as doctrine, design language, or public explanation.

implements.label: Implements
implements.definition: The Atlas entity implements a Tree concept through code, schema, manifest, workflow, or service behavior.

documents.label: Documents
documents.definition: The Atlas entity documents, researches, or explains a Tree concept without necessarily implementing it.

presents.label: Presents
presents.definition: The Atlas entity presents a Tree concept to public users through an interface or publication surface.

supports.label: Supports
supports.definition: The Atlas entity provides enabling infrastructure, tooling, or context for a Tree concept.

governs.label: Governs
governs.definition: The Atlas entity supplies policy, consent, evidence, or authority boundaries for a Tree concept.

researches.label: Researches
researches.definition: The Atlas entity investigates a Tree concept through bounded research or exploratory analysis.

instantiates.label: Instantiates
instantiates.definition: The Atlas entity is a current public manifestation of a Tree concept without becoming its definition.

entities.label: AIFT-Genesis
entities.description: Canonical civilization genome repository for schemas, manifests, templates, Tree of Life, Living Atlas doctrine, and the Tree of Emergence graph.

metadata.claimBoundary: Defines canonical contracts and doctrine; does not operate every downstream system.

entities.label: AIFT-Forge
entities.description: Federation core repository for reusable Explorer engine behavior, agentic infrastructure language, repository/build/package patterns, and shared operating doctrine.

metadata.claimBoundary: Foundation and reusable engine work; no stable release or audited security status is claimed here.

entities.label: www.aifreedomtrust.com
entities.description: Public static portal and mission-facing doorway for the AI Freedom Trust Federation.

metadata.claimBoundary: Public orientation surface; the portal returns readers to the repositories that own deeper authority.

entities.label: AI-Freedom-Trust
entities.description: Public doctrine, research, PDFs, AetherCore empirical package, review packet, and Aetherion reading editions.

metadata.claimBoundary: Exploratory research and doctrine are public but do not prove all Federation claims.

entities.label: VPS
entities.description: Public infrastructure repository for AIFT Cloud App Foundry, decentralized VPS, app builder, provider network, naming, and registry foundations.

metadata.claimBoundary: Infrastructure foundation; live runtime state belongs in a future Runtime overlay.

entities.label: Aether Coin Biozonecurrency
entities.description: Public stewardship repository for Aetherion wallet, regenerative value protocol, AI-guided digital stewardship, and cryptographic trust interface research.

metadata.claimBoundary: Protocol and wallet research; no custody, financial, legal, or audited security claim is implied.

entities.label: Capital City Provisions
entities.description: Applied business repository for practical customer operations, quote capture, delivery review, and concierge support proof-of-work.

metadata.claimBoundary: Applied software and operations surface; public records do not verify live revenue or order volume.

entities.label: Aetherion Flight Paper
entities.description: Public Aetherion flight paper integrating post-quantum architecture, anti-centralization doctrine, Circleunchain, AI concerns, and biozoe coin economics.

metadata.claimBoundary: Conceptual, philosophical, technical, governance, and ecosystem architecture draft.

entities.label: AetherCore Empirical Trust Paper
entities.description: Public empirical paper and reproducible research package for trust-density exploratory analysis.

metadata.claimBoundary: Exploratory and awaiting external review; no formal peer review or causal proof is claimed.

entities.label: Tree Explorer v1
entities.description: Public browser Explorer that consumes the Genesis Tree manifest through the reusable Forge engine.

metadata.claimBoundary: Public preview over canonical Genesis data; it is not itself a canonical graph source.

treeMappings.description: Genesis defines trust seed schemas, templates, governance doctrine, and inheritance rules that support trust-system instantiation.
Genesis carries machine-readable manifests, schemas, and provenance conventions for governed repository inheritance.
Genesis contains AI stewardship doctrine and local-first boundaries for how AI participation is inherited by trust seeds.
Forge provides reusable software foundations, package boundaries, and Explorer engine behavior.
Forge documents repository, build, release, package, and agentic infrastructure patterns for Federation repositories.
Forge records agentic infrastructure language and AI governance boundaries for reusable software workflows.
The public portal presents Federation documentation and the Tree Explorer through GitHub Pages.
The public portal orients visitors across distinct Federation repositories without becoming their source of truth.
AI-Freedom-Trust publishes doctrine, research, PDFs, review packets, and source summaries as public knowledge artifacts.
AI-Freedom-Trust publishes AI Freedom Trust doctrine, research framing, and Aetherion materials involving AI systems and governance.
VPS is the public infrastructure lane for app foundry, provider network, naming, routing, and deployment foundations.
Aether_Coin_biozonecurrency is a public stewardship repository for Aetherion wallet and regenerative value protocol research.
The repository is described publicly as AI-guided digital stewardship and wallet intelligence research, without implying autonomous custody.
Capital City Provisions is an applied business lane for customer operations and accountable workflow proof-of-work.
The Aetherion Flight Paper is a public conceptual and architectural draft for the Aetherion vision.
The Aetherion Flight Paper discusses AI modules and governance concerns as conceptual architecture, not as deployed AI infrastructure.
The AetherCore empirical paper researches trust-density patterns with explicit exploratory and review limitations.
Tree Explorer v1 publicly presents canonical Genesis graph knowledge through a reusable Forge engine.
Tree Explorer v1 demonstrates the separation between canonical Genesis data, Forge engine behavior, and portal composition.
